note.en: Direct pair summation with identical particles and Plummer softening is the numerical standard. Compare force errors by tree opening angle and multipole order.

note.en: Check mass conservation, mass-weighted internal force and a manufactured Fourier solution of mesh Poisson. This does not establish force accuracy against a general periodic particle direct sum.

name.ja: 周期PM粒子群：質量・内力・格子場
name.en: Periodic PM particles: mass, internal force and mesh field

note.ja: 入力JSONに保存した19粒子の周期CIC–FFT–CIC計算。質量、内力和、単粒子自己力、整数箱長移動を確認し、別の正弦密度の解析的周期Poisson場と照合。
note.en: Periodic CIC–FFT–CIC calculation for 19 particles stored explicitly in input JSON. Check mass, net internal force, single-particle self-force and integer-box translation; separately compare a sinusoidal density with analytic periodic Poisson fields.

name.ja: PIC空間演算の独立実装照合

note.ja: ベクトル化CIC/FFTと、別に書いた粒子ループCIC・密なDFTを、それぞれが自己無撞着な場を毎kick計算する軌道全体で照合します。
note.en: Compare vectorized CIC/FFT with separately authored scalar-particle CIC/dense DFT; each trajectory sources its own field at every kick.

note.ja: 熱速度1のMaxwell分布を自己無撞着に動かし、減衰率・周波数・符号付き場の履歴を独立した線形参照で調べます。
note.en: Advance thermal Maxwellian full-f particles and compare damping rate, frequency and signed-field history with qualified independent linear references.

name.ja: 温かいPICの二流初期成長

note.ja: 温度を持つ対向Maxwell二流を時間発展し、固定した線形窓の成長率と過渡を分散式・Volterra参照から分けて検査します。
note.en: Evolve counter-streaming warm Maxwellians; distinguish fixed-window growth and transients using dielectric and Volterra references.
